name: 7+3 + Midostaurin (FLT3-mutated)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
Tumor-lysis prophylaxis: hydration and allopurinol (or rasburicase if high risk); monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid.
Antifungal prophylaxis choice must account for azole-midostaurin CYP3A4 interaction.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.

drugs.name: Cytarabine
drugs.notes: Continuous IV infusion 100-200 mg/m2/day on days 1-7 (the '7' of 7+3); 100 mg/m2/day is the common backbone dose. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Daunorubicin
drugs.notes: Daunorubicin 60-90 mg/m2 IV push on days 1-3 (the '3' of 7+3); 60 mg/m2 shown, use 90 mg/m2 in younger fit adults per physician judgement. Track cumulative anthracycline exposure (warn ~450, hard ~550 mg/m2). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Midostaurin
drugs.notes: 50 mg PO twice daily on days 8-21 of each induction/consolidation cycle, added to 7+3 for FLT3-mutated AML; continue through consolidation and as maintenance where used. Take with food. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
